name: @waste/tooling
description: Development-only helpers shared by the workspace packages: the purity gate (import scan with a direction, manifest and tsconfig checks) that keeps domain and contracts free of the web app, browser and Node globals; the wire-values gate that keeps contracts stating no value of its own; the shipping program's modules imported for a walk over every export; the one rule for finding the database under test or skipping without it; a database that is down two ways, refused and silent, for the readiness probes' tests; turbo.json's task env lists, which each app's declared environment is held to; and the specimen proving the web app's ESLint fence against the database. Never a runtime dependency.
